name: Advanced Order Status For WooCommerce
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
Advanced Order Status for WooCommerce by Versesofts lets you create professional, customized order statuses tailored to your store’s workflow. Enhance your WooCommerce admin with color-coded labels, icons, bulk updates, and seamless HPOS support for faster order management.

Whether you run a small shop or a large-scale store, this plugin helps you build a clear, efficient order pipeline so your team can track, filter, and act on orders quickly.

Learn more: Product Page • Documentation

Key Features:

  • Create unlimited custom order statuses
  • Assign custom colors to status labels
  • Add icons (Dashicons) to status labels
  • Bulk update order statuses from Orders screen
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Works with WooCommerce email notifications
  • Simple, fast UI integrated in WooCommerce
  • Designed for high performance stores

Use cases:

  • Add statuses like “Awaiting Payment Proof”, “Packed”, “Ready for Pickup”, “Shipped (Carrier)”.
  • Improve team collaboration with clear visual cues and bulk actions.
  • Build an order workflow that matches your business process.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/advanced-order-status-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Order Statuses to create and manage your custom statuses
  4. Use the new statuses in your order management workflow
sections.faq:
Where can I get support?

• Website: https://www.versesofts.com/
• Products: https://www.versesofts.com/products
• Documentation: https://www.versesofts.com/docs/advanced-order-status
• Feature Request: https://www.versesofts.com/feature-request?plugin=advanced-order-status
• Contact: https://www.versesofts.com/contact

Can I edit existing WooCommerce order statuses?

No, this plugin only allows you to create new custom order statuses. Default WooCommerce statuses cannot be modified.

Will my custom statuses work with email notifications?

Yes, custom statuses work with WooCommerce email notifications. You can set up custom emails for your new statuses using WooCommerce email settings.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

What happens to orders with custom statuses if I deactivate the plugin?

Orders with custom statuses will retain their status labels, but the custom styling and icons will no longer be displayed until you reactivate the plugin.
